start.name_zh: 三邑分输站（三邑调控中心）

end.geocode_source: Nominatim query 'Pidu District, Chengdu' (district-level centroid; matches GEM's own EndLocation field 'Pi County')

corridor_notes: This PID is the '(Pidu Section)' of the wider 'Xinchang-Sanyi-Tianfu New District' gas pipeline (part of the Sichuan & Chongqing Grand Loop Line / 川渝大环线). Per prior ResearcherNotes, the overall project has Phase I (Xinchang-Sanyi) and Phase II (Sanyi-Tianfu New District), with the Pidu section belonging to Phase II. A Sichuan provincial procurement notice (ggzyjy.sc.gov.cn, 2025-12) for periodic long-distance-pipeline inspection names the full system '新场-三邑-郫县（含联通线、三三线）输气管道' (Xinchang-Sanyi-Pixian Gas Pipeline, incl. Liantong Line + Sansan Line) with stations 新场首站 (Xinchang First Station), 三邑调控中心 (Sanyi Control Center), 郫县分输站 (Pixian/Pidu Distribution Station), and trunk segments: Xinchang-Sanyi 42.6km (DN700), Sanyi-Pixian 49.68km (DN800), plus a 4.3km Liantong (connector) line and a 7.1km Sansan line -- total ~103.68km, crossing Chengdu and Deyang municipalities with a spur through Pengzhou. GEM's LengthMergedKm for this PID (21.00km) does not match the full 49.68km Sanyi-Pixian trunk length in the source, suggesting GEM's 'Pidu Section' captures only the portion of that trunk lying within Pidu District itself (the source separately notes a Pixian-Distribution-Station-to-boundary segment length ~7.8km in a related citation), or a different sub-division of the network than the one this procurement doc describes. Could not independently confirm Sanyi Distribution Station's exact town/county (candidate hits for a '三邑' place name in OSM -- a '三邑桥' bridge in Xindu District and a '三邑大桥' bridge in Pengzhou's Juntun town -- are inconclusive name matches, not confirmed station locations, so no coordinate was assigned for the start point per the no-invention rule).
researcher_notes: GEM's stated LengthMergedKm (21.00km) is shorter than the sourced Sanyi-Pixian trunk length (49.68km), consistent with the 'Pidu Section' being a sub-segment rather than the full Sanyi-Pixian run -- flagging for confirmation rather than treating as a discrepancy to fix. GEM's EndLocation 'Pi County' is corroborated by the source's 郫县分输站 terminus.
blockers: No verified source pins Sanyi Distribution Station to a specific town/county, so the start point has no coordinate (name only). A source combining the phrase '新场-三邑-天府新区（郫都段）' verbatim was not found; the corroborating source instead documents the closely related '新场-三邑-郫县' inspection-service system, which is treated as the same physical trunk based on shared station names (三邑, 郫县/郫都) and segment structure.
